node.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1)

Artoria Pendragon, better known as Arthur Pendragon and King Arthur, is regarded as a male in history but is actually female. She is the "Once and Future King" and a legendary hero of Britain known as the King of Knights. She used to wield the sword from the stone, Caliburn, but it was eventually destroyed and the Lady of the Lake gifted her with Excalibur and Avalon.

__In Fate/Prototype:__ ~!He is presented as male instead, conserving his original name of Arthur Pendragon. Also called Prototype Saber, he is the Saber-class Servant under the control of [Ayaka Sajyou](https://anilist.co/character/54223).!~

__In Fate/stay night:__ ~!Saber is summoned in the Fifth Holy Grail War as the Servant of [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496). Shirou had been having dreams of Excalibur in the days leading up to the start of the Holy Grail War after receiving his Command Spells and, while stumbling in his shed during his escape from [Lancer](https://anilist.co/character/499), Avalon, hidden inside him, reacts to the traces of a magic circle and summons Artoria as his Servant.!~

__In Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel:__ ~! Corrupted by [Angra Mainyu](https://anilist.co/character/120855), Artoria is vastly different from her normal self. She is also called Saber Alter/Black Saber. The results of her alteration is not only within Artoria's interior but also extends to her outward appearance. The color of her skin becomes pale, and the pupil of her eyes that were at first concealed behind a black visor during the moment of her summoning becomes golden from her original green eye color as well. Because the armor she wears was dyed jet black and grew in weight due to changing into a heavier armor, its power has increased more than normal.!~

 __In Fate/Zero:__ ~!Saber is summoned by [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010) to participate in the Fourth Holy Grail War on behalf of [Jubstacheit von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/16027) and the Einzbern family. Kiritsugu partners Saber with [Irisviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/15164), to act as Saber's Master in the open while he acts from behind to win with his own methods.!~ 

__In Fate/Grand Order - First Order:__  ~! She remains the corrupted version, known as Saber Alter.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order Camelot:__ ~!The being called Goddess Rhongomyniad came into existence in the world that [Bedivere](https://anilist.co/character/8941), due to the wish of wanting his King to not perish after the battle of Camlainn, refused to throw Excalibur back into the Lake even after the third time.!~

**Height:** 164 cm

Rider of Black is the Rider-class Servant of [Selenik Icecol Yggdmillennia](https://anilist.co/character/122393/Icecolle-Yggdmillennia-Celenike) as part of the Black Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha.  Black Rider's identity is Astolfo, the Twelfth Paladin of Charlemagne.

~!In the Charlemagne Legend, he is the son of an English king, and one of [Charlemagne](https://anilist.co/character/259823/Charlemagne)'s twelve faithful Paladins. He is beautiful beyond all compare, but he is also a frightfully unparalleled blabbermouth, prone to speaking on and on until those involved lose all rationality. His conversations, through no ill intent on his part, have a way of meandering toward maximum social awkwardness. His hobby of adventuring gets himself mixed up in an assorted amount of mischief due to him constantly popping up everywhere. He states that his hair ornaments, which seem like something a princess would wear, are an "irresistible proof of friendship" that he uses to restore peace to his depressively mad boon ally, [Orlando](https://anilist.co/character/286219/Roland).!~

__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3)

Ruler's True Name is Jeanne d'Arc, the Saint of Orleans. A Catholic saint born in Domrémy, France, and the heroine of France who liberated Orléans in the Hundred Years' War.

A Ruler Class Servant is the Standard-Bearer who Correctly Guides the Holy Grail War. Jeanne is a special Heroic Spirit summoned by the Holy Grail itself to act as the administrator of the Holy Grail War instead of the Church. Being summoned in the Ruler class also allows her to retain the memories of each repeating "game" unlike other Servants.

Jeanne d'Arc was a common farmer's daughter. She claims she had received the command of God to fight. She heard the Lord’s lament that the world changed straight into hell. The Lord wept into sorrow as no one could stop it and people were not even allowed to live simply, and were compelled to become either beasts or food. Conflict never ended, and blood continued to rain incessantly and soak the land. She received a revelation from the Lord, the voice contained no glory or victory, no obligation or sense of purpose but only the Lord laments. She caught his small, feeble murmurs that everyone else failed to hear. 

Jeanne also has a minor cameo in the second season of Fate/Zero.

Mordred is the "son" of [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) though, in reality, she is a woman. 

[Morgan le Fay](https://anilist.co/character/239533/le-Fay-Morgan), Artoria's sister, created Mordred as a homunculus clone of the King. Morgan grew Mordred in secret, inculcating her the desire to usurp the King and ascend to the throne as the rightful heir. To achieve this objective Mordred was made to be one of the Knights of the Round Table. 

With time Mordred grew to idolize her "father", but the King refused to recognize her as a rightful heir. These clashing feelings of love and hate made Mordred play an important role in the fall of Camelot.

__In Fate/Apocrypha:__
~!Mordred is the Saber-class Servant of [Kairi Shishigou](https://anilist.co/character/122397/Shishigou-Kairi) as part of the Red Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War.!~

node.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm
~!185 cm (As Lord El-Melloi II)!~

Waver Velvet is a nineteen year old student at Clock Tower, an institute of the Magus Association, and mage with a recognized magical lineage of three generations. While he is talented, he is not recognized by his peers or lecturers.

An intelligent young man, Waver came up with the revolutionary concept that a mage's power could be increased through effort, experience, and knowledge rather than increasing magical potential through that of a mage's heirs. His idea is dismissed by his lecturer, the nobleman [Kayneth Archibald El-Melloi](https://anilist.co/character/16028), who tears up Waver's manuscript without another thought.

~!The Fourth Holy Grail War drastically changed his life, and before he realized it, he was suffering under the weight of the El-Melloi family’s mantle as one of the twelve Lords that rule and manage the Clock Tower, and the current head of the El-Melloi family. He wears his long hair straight, but it is kept quite well.!~
~!He also became a famous lecturer in the Clock Tower. Despite being hopeless as a magus, his skill as a lecturer dominates the rest, and is the best person at detecting the hidden talent of others and training it. There are no magi that were his students that hadn't obtained the rank of Grand, and it's even been said that if he gathered his students together, the power chart in the Clock Tower would change.!~

Merlin is believed to be the son of the Princess of Wales and an Incubus, his mixed blood and his astounding talent for magic make him one of the greatest Mages that ever lived and one of the few qualified to be a Grand Caster. Like all the most supreme mages he possesses powerful Clairvoyance abilities. Merlin's, however, allows him only to see the present. 

He served first [Uther Pendragon](https://anilist.co/character/316370/Pendragon-Uther) and then his heir [Artoria](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) as a counselor and court mage, aiding her during her reign. He, however, disappeared soon before the fall of Camelot into the mists of Avalon. There, locked in a tower, he is unable to die and observes the world through his clairvoyance.

Since he is not technically dead and registered in the Throne of Heroes, he couldn't be summoned as a Servant, however, the mischievous Merlin has a hobby of bypassing this rule through loopholes.

Lancer of Red is the Lancer-class Servant of Shirou Kotomine of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. Originally summoned by one of the five puppet Masters of the Red Faction, he later becomes one of the Servants of Shirou.

~!Lancer's identity is Karna, Son of the Sun God, the invulnerable hero of the Indian epic Mahabharata. Karna was born between a human mother Kunti and the Sun God Surya. As proof of being the son of Surya, he was given a golden armor that granted invulnerability. Karna was born to become a great hero. However, Kunti abandoned Karna and became the queen of King Kuru. Not knowing who his mother was, Karna grew up with a low social status. However, he soon made his existence known to the world by becoming the honored guest of the Royal House Kauravas, who were hostile to King Kuru. Karna participated in the wars around the borders and fought on an equal footing with Arjuna, son of Kunti and Thunder God Indra. Karna eventually fell in battle after being robbed of his golden armor by Indra, suffering many curses, and losing all of his allies. He died in the hands of his half-brother Arjuna. However, he did not hate anyone and accepted his death.!~

(Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

Servant of Shirou as part of the Red Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha.

Assassin's identity is Semiramis, Wise Queen of Assyria (アッシリアの賢女王), a legendary queen who reigned over the empire of Assyria. Since her childhood, she has studied a wide range of disciplines such as cosmetics, hairdressing, dancing, clothing, music, astronomy, and her beautiful face has captivated many men. A very enthusiastic person, she indulges in luxury and decadence. Her passion has led her to start a war to possess a single man, and to poison her husband, the king, for politics. But her abilities as a queen are indisputable, as she has led many expeditions, as seen on walls and the Ishtar Gate. She uses poison as her weapon.

(Source: Type-Moon Wiki)

__Height:__ 163 cm 
__Servant type:__ Caster

~!An honored guest of the Ryudou family​ permitted to live at their temple until the preparations for her marriage have been finalized. A gorgeous and talented yet mysterious woman of high stature, her presence has attracted the attention of many trainee monks.!~

alternative: Aka no Archer (赤のアーチャー)

node.description:
Archer of "Red" is the Archer-class Servant of [Rottweil Berzinsky](https://anilist.co/character/232918/Berzinsky-Rottweil) of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. [Shirou Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/35603/Amakusa--Shirou-Tokisada) assumes command over her before she even meets her Master, and through his machinations, he later officially becomes Archer's Master.

Archer's True Name is Atalanta, a famous huntress known as the Chaste Huntress that appears in Greek Mythology. She is a huntress who is famous for her swift feet in Ancient Greek legend. She became famous after being the first one to drive an arrow into the Calydonian Boar during its extermination. Also, she is included as a member of the Argonauts, which assembled brave heroes from all over Greece. She has the tragic past of being born as the daughter of a king of a certain country and yet being abandoned in the mountains by her father.

~!Atalanta was born as the daughter of King Iasus of Arcadia. However, although she was born in and as the princess of the natural paradise, Atalanta ended up being abandoned in the forests and on the mountains immediately she was born as she was shunned by her father - who desired a son. But she survived thanks to the divine protection from Artemis, a virgin goddess who felt pity for her. Artemis sent and made a female bear, a sacred beast of the goddess, nurture the girl by giving her milk and raising her up. In gratitude, Atalanta is a fervent follower of Artemis!~

~!During the final battle in Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha, Atalanta faces [Ruler](https://anilist.co/character/67769/dArc-Jeanne) who she still blames for the death of the children that make up [Jack the Ripper](https://anilist.co/character/55951/Jack-the-Ripper). She activates her personal Noble Phantasm, Agrius Metamorphosis, which not only transforms her into a monstrous version of herself, but increases her physical abilities. Ruler expresses pure disgust at Atalanta for discarding her heroic side and reducing herself to a rabid monster.!~

node.description:
Morgan le Fay is the sister of [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497) and mother of [Gawain](https://anilist.co/character/138357), [Agravain](https://anilist.co/character/220186), [Gaheris](https://anilist.co/character/302881), [Gareth](https://anilist.co/character/239525) and [Mordred](https://anilist.co/character/55977).
 Morgan was the daughter of Tintagel, the fae child conceived by Igraine, the progeny of the British Isles... and later, Artoria's stepsister, as Morgan's mother Igraine wed King Uther.

__In Fate/Apocrypha:__ 

~![Kairi Sisigou](https://anilist.co/character/122397) has dreams of Mordred's past showing how Morgan encouraged her to join the Knights of the Round Table, and later revealed to Mordred that she was King Arthur's son and encouraged her to turn against Arthur.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order Cosmos in the Lostbelt:__ 

~!She established an authoritarian monarchy in the Lostbelt Britain and has made the fairies suffer under her oppressive rule for 2000 years. As the highest-ranking fairy, she is a genius sorcerer who has mastered Rhongomyniad, the Lance that Shines to the Ends of the World, as a form of Magecraft.!~

__Height:__ 187 cm

Sir Bedivere was among the first Knights of the Round table, and he remained faithful to the [King](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) until the end. 

Although he was the one who closest guarded the King, he never saw her smile nor learned of her identity as a woman. After attending the King's death he found himself initially unable to return Excalibur to the [Lady of the Lake](https://anilist.co/character/333146/Vivian), for that would signal Artoria was truly gone. Though sad the hard work of his King was not properly rewarded, he understood her Fate could not be changed and finally returned the Sword, hoping she would find a peaceful slumber.

__In Fate/Grand Order Divine Realm of the Round Table:__

~!In this version of History he was unable to return Excalibur, making it impossible for Artoria to pass away and reach Avalon. He has been wandering the Earth for 1500 years, wrought with guilt, trying to finally complete the task the King assigned him!~

name.native: フランケンシュタイン

node.description:
Berserker is Frankenstein, Frankenstein's monster, the homunculus created by Victor Frankenstein appearing in Mary Shelley's novel. Into the Great Holy Grail War Berserker is summoned by Caules Forvedge Yggdmillennia with Victor Frankenstein's plans for a "perfect human" as a catalyst

~!Berserker's True Name is Frankenstein (フランケンシュタイン, Furankenshutain), the Frankenstein's monster (フランケンシュタインの怪物, Furankenshutain no Kaibutsu). Based upon the artificial life created by Victor Frankenstein in Mary Shelley's novel "Frankenstein: or the Modern Prometheus". Victor sought to recreate the original couple described in the bible -- Adam and Eve. Due to the limitations of man, he first built Eve, intending for her to give birth to the counterpart. What started as a patchwork of lifeless flesh was given life by the energy harnessed from lightning. Unfortunately, what awoke was not the ideal woman that Victor envisioned, but an abomination with the mind of an infant. Having no developed capacity for expression, her sense of morality was completely absent. After presenting the entrails of a slain dog as a gift for the master, she was branded a failure and disassembled, before being abandoned completely.!~

node.description:
Jack the Ripper is a Servant of the Assassin class and one of the main characters in Fate/Apocrypha.

She is a young girl who embodies contradiction itself, combining the dual natures of "day" and "night." She displays a childish manner of speech, but she is truly quick of thought. Rationality dominates her behavior, but there are many inherent weaknesses to her psyche. Her personality is both pure and cruel, and she is inclined to repay cruelty with cruelty and benevolence with benevolence. Her psyche is inherently broken, and mistreatment toward her may result in irreversible deterioration. While needing to feed on the souls of humans to keep herself in existence, she claims that she will only eat evil people because their souls "taste" better.

alternative: Shirou Kotomine (シロウ・コトミネ)

node.description:
The Master of [Assasin of Red](https://anilist.co/character/35596/Semiramis), Shirou was dispatched by the Church as one of the Masters of the Red Faction. 

~!He is actually a Ruler-class Servant of the [Einzbern Master](https://anilist.co/character/286211/Einzbern-Master)‎‎ in the Third Holy Grail War. He was later materialized due to having come into contact with the Greater Grail and managing to receive flesh.!~

He wants to make use of the Holy Grail War to fulfill his own wish. He has no connection to [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) of the [Fate/stay night](https://anilist.co/manga/30715/Fatestay-night/) timeline.

__Height:__ 191 cm   
__Weight:__ 81 kg  

In Fate/Zero
    ~!Berserker is the Servant of Matou Kariya during the 4th Holy Grail War. Berserker is known to have three distinct Noble Phantasms, as shown on his status page. However, due to the enchantment that obscured his identity, his status page was shown blurred, making it impossible to identify the specific names and natures of his Phantasms, save for the sword Arondight. In addition, this Berserker is uniquely able to make anything he chooses into his own Noble Phantasm and effectively wield them, from telephone poles to the Noble Phantasms of other Servants.
Berserker's real identity is Lancelot of the Lake. Until his identity was revealed, he had been known simply as the Black Knight.  Lancelot, known as the Knight of the Lake, had been loyal to Artoria, knowing both the king and the secrets of her sword well. Lancelot's downfall began when he loved Artoria's queen. Though the king was actually a woman, Artoria had married in order to present the image of a stable royal family before the kingdom and to maintain the illusion that she was a man in the face of the general public. Her queen willingly sacrificed her own life as a woman in order to fulfill the ideal of the stable government. However, Lancelot and the queen fell in love. Though he wanted to take her away, Lancelot's loyalty to Artoria and his sense of duty to serve the kingdom prevented him from doing so. When political enemies of the king exposed Lancelot and the queen's affair, the queen was ordered to be executed. Left with little choice, Lancelot rebelled in order to try and save her. The knight, the queen, who had made her beloved betray his duty, and the king, who felt responsible for the despair her most loyal servant endured, all suffered. Though Lancelot suffered greatly, he found that he could not hate Artoria, who had never blamed Lancelot for anything regarding the state of affairs they had become entangled in. In his despair, Lancelot desired to become a beast who had no worries; thus, when he became a Heroic Spirit, he became a Berserker-class spirit. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

__In Fate/Stay Night:__
~!The Servant of [Illya](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel), he is a swarthy giant with adamantine skin and gross brawn. He wields a colossal stone Axe-Sword, and is capable of causing massive destruction with the mere backlash of his swings. As a Berserker, he was stripped of his sanity and reason, acting feral and animalistic in combat. Berserkers are praised as members of the "Strongest" class, though they are difficult to control. Illya, however, appears to have little trouble managing Berserker.!~

Sieg was created by Yggdmillennia as one of their many homunculi suited to various purposes. Initially kept in a prana supply tank devised by Gordes Musik Yggdmillennia to grant energy for Servants, he was one of many allowed to be used by Caster of Black for usage as harvesting materials for his golems. Due to his unexpectedly high quality Magic Circuits, he was thought to be a good choice for Caster's Golem Keter Malkuth.

Sieg comes into consciousness without anything to form a personality. He is scared of everything but himself, believing to be nothing. He calls himself transparent and colorless because he possesses nothing and had received nothing from his birth. 

(Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

alternative: Rider of Red (赤のライダー)

node.description:
Rider of "Red" is the Rider-class Servant of Cabik Pentel of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. Shirou Kotomine assumes command over him before he even meets his Master, and through his machinations he later officially becomes Rider's Master.

~!Rider's True Name is Achilles (アキレウス, Akireusu), one of the famous heroes in the Trojan Wars. Born from the sea goddess Thetis and the hero Peleus, Achilles was blessed by the gods from birth. His mother Thetis, having greatly loved her son, had warmed him within holy flames in order to try and make him immortal. But her husband Peleus had opposed it, saying “Then that would destroy Achilles as a human”, and in the end Achilles grew up while only a certain part of him remained human. Eventually, when war broke out between Troia and Achaea, Achilles was asked the following by his mother Thetis: "Do you wish to live a long and peaceful life without having your name recognized by the masses? Or do you wish to live the short life of a hero with brilliant achievements in battle?" Achilles choice went without saying. At the same time as his mother felt pride in his decision, she also felt heartbreakingly sad, because his fate had been predetermined since he was born. If he lived as a hero, he would have a short life, as if sprinting through it at full speed.!~
Master of [Mordred Pendragon](https://anilist.co/character/55977/Pendragon-Mordred).

name.native: フラット・エスカルドス

node.description:
He is the Master of [Berserker](https://anilist.co/character/87321/Berserker) in the Holy Grail War in Snowfield. 

A student at the Clock Tower, the greatest school backed by the Magic Association, he is overcome by a great desire to go see the Holy Grail in Snowfield. While he is talented, he lacks the proper disposition to be a Magus. His teacher is [Lord El-Melloi II](https://anilist.co/character/16023/Velvet-Waver).

Siegfried is the hero portrayed as the main character of the German Nibelungenlied epic. Prince of the Netherlands, he wields the precious sword Balmung which he received from the Nibelungen family and has fought in many campaigns and adventures. His most well-known feat is killing the evil dragon Fafnir. He then bathed in the blood of the dragon and has obtained an invincible body. 

In Fate/Apocrypha
~!He is the Servant of Gordes Musik Yggdmillennia as part of the Black Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War. He killed himself and gave his heart to Sieg so that he would be able to live a full life. Sieg named himself this to honor Siegfried's sacrifice.    !~  (Source: Type-Moon Wiki)

__Height:__ 196 cm  


In Fate/Zero
~!He is the Servant of Ryuunosuke Uryuu during the 4th Holy Grail War. Caster derives pleasure from first providing his victims with a moment of relief and hope, before killing them in a variety of horrific manners.  Caster was summoned shortly before the Fourth Holy Grail War began. His Master was Ryuunosuke Uryuu, a serial killer who unwittingly performed a successful summoning ritual using the blood of a murdered family. Like his Master, he is almost devoid of any morality and has no interest in obtaining the Holy Grail. He enjoys offering his victims brief moments of respite, or even the hope of release or escape, before inflicting death through gruesome and horrific means. According to Caster, allowing his victims hope will amplify the despair and terror upon their moment of death, a fact that he revels in. He also uses his magic to warp and twist humans into contraptions for his Master's entertainment, such as turning a girl into a pipe organ. 
In his past life, he was a French nobleman who was once a comrade-in-arms of Jeanne of Arc. He first introduces himself to his Master as Bluebeard, which is the name of a fictional character based on Gille himself.!~

Caster of Red is the Caster-class Servant of Jean Rum of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha.

Placing the importance of the Story above all else, he lies and cheats and by any means conduct himself that he might witness the unfolding of a grand tale, beautiful beyond compare. Consequently, he tends to distance himself from mentality of the "participant," taking instead the perspective of an abstract, "Authorial" third person. His regard for others differs by individual, dependent on their qualification as a special existence, or "protagonist." He interacts with "normal humans" only in a shallow, dismissive manner, and expresses an extreme interest in "protagonists." In slight narcissism, he frequently drops such self-authored quotes as, "Things bad begun make strong themselves by ill." He's taken a liking to certain terminology from modern fiction, such as "Death-Flagging." With short and effective words, he brings to light that what humans usually keep hidden. This is like suddenly being poked by rambling, incongruous words, so one would probably feel shocked.

As the world is the greatest story ever told to him, or so it ought to be in his eyes, he willingly employs deception, provocation, or anything else for the sake of spinning the story. He greatly loves those who are out of the ordinary from the bottom of his heart, perusing the tales they spin. With greatly exaggerated outbursts of emotion, he acts as he wishes, gracefully admitting that it is suitable to call him a trickster.

~!Caster's true name is William Shakespeare (ウィリアム・シェイクスピア), a poet and playwright from the Elizabethan England.
His father was an affluent man in Stratford, but it is uncertain if Shakespeare received a higher education. Half of his life is shrouded in mystery and there are many mysteries in his career, such as an undocumented gap of seven years. In his early days as a playwright, his productions revolved around comedy, then historical drama, before he changed his style for magnificent tragedy. At the same time, he also played as an actor in the underground, and he was the target of slander and derision from influential people. In any case, he just had to write a few works and his reputation didn't know where to stop. Considering how he was belittled by a senior playwright as a "upstart Crow" at the time, it seems that he was quite envied.
He is the only playwright whose fame has reached around the world, he is representative of authors of the western world. His name shines brilliantly on the history of English literature, his popularity as a great man from England is the highest possible. Still having a large influence over modern literature, it can be said that those with no knowledge of his works are to be disparaged as ignorant. It is also said that those looking to trace the source of any piece of modern literature will always find a Shakespearean creation. Having written too many masterpieces to list, his four greatest tragedies rising above all others are "Othello," "Macbeth," "Hamlet" and "King Lear."!~

(Source: Type Moon Wikia)

alternative: Kuro no Archer (黒のアーチャー‚ Archer of Black)

node.description:
Archer of "Black" is the Archer-class Servant of Fiore Forvedge Yggdmillennia of the Black Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha.

~!Archer's True Name is Chiron (ケイローン, Keirōn), a centaur, half man and half horse, who was known as a great sage among his kind in Greek mythology. He is the son of the Titan Cronus, patron of the harvest and the earth, and the deity Philyra, making him a Divine Spirit that would not normally qualify for the status of Heroic Spirit. Philyra, ashamed of her offspring's half man and half horse appearance, asked to be transformed into a linden tree by the gods. !~

alternative: White Knight of the Round Table

node.description:
__Height:__ 180cm

One of the Knights of the Round Table that appeared in the Arthurian legends, also known as the White Knight of the Round Table.
If King Arthur was the night, the symbol of the moon itself, then Sir Gawain was the day, which shoulders the sun. He acted as [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497)'s impersonator in the royal castle of Camelot. In other words, he was one of the candidates to substitute the King after his fall. He is the bearer of the sister-sword to Excalibur, Excalibur Galatine.

__In Fate/Extra,__ ~!he's summoned by [Leonardo B. Harwey](https://anilist.co/character/127156) as a Saber-class Servant for the Moon Holy Grail War, bein the last Servant that [Hakuno Kishinami](https://anilist.co/character/84485) faces. Later, with their defeat, Leo finally learns of defeat and thanks Gawain for his services; Gawain points out to him that he was honored to witness an honorable king before fading away.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order Camelot,__ ~!Gawain, along with the other Knights who swore allegiance to the [Lion King](https://anilist.co/character/497), slew the remainder of the Round Table (including his little sister Gareth), and was, like the others, given a divine Gift to help him "pacify" the people of the Singularity, that being the Gift of Nightlessness: making the sun shine anywhere he goes even at night ensuring he is at his peak at all times. Gawain is placed in charge of the Holy Gate, the entrance to the White City of Camelot.!~

name.native: フィオレ・フォルヴェッジ・ユグドミレニア

node.description:
Lancer of "Black" ("黒"のランサー, "Kuro" no Ransā) is the Lancer-class Servant of Darnic Prestone Yggdmillennia of the Black Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. 

Lancer's True Name is Vlad III (ヴラド三世, Vurado Sansei), the Lord Impaler (串刺し公, Kushizashi Kō) (1431-1476), the greatest hero of Wallachia, whose feats in war caused him to be known fearsomely as the "Impaling Prince" to the Turks. Due to the legends associated with him, another name has been spread across the world, The Little Dragon, better known as the vampire Count Dracula. While the nation was small, he was a hero who ascended to the throne and managed to turn back the numerous invasions of the Ottoman Empire that had trampled over every other country. Though the model for Dracula, he was not a vampire, but a man of devotion and great hero.

It is said that the difference between him and his counterpart is their aspects being different, Fate/Apocrypha's version being Vlad III's aspect as a King, while his Fate/EXTRA counterpart is his aspect of a Warrior.

One of the Knights of the Round Table from Arthurian legends.

The tale of Tristan and Iseult, the woman he loved, is a legend boasting outstanding popularity in Europe. Tristan served the king as a good knight— and the king too had a deep trust in this handsome knight.

Artemis is a pure virgin goddess that would unfailingly shoot through those who sought to attain the magical power that pulls the tides and causes them to rise, the link to the moon's movements, and simultaneously granting these infidels death and disease. She is one of many goddesses whose power is derived from the Earth Mother.

As the "Goddess of the Hunt", Artemis was the divine protector of Atalanta, and granted her the bow Tauropolos, named for one of Artemis' epithets. She lent her power to the Noble Phantasm Phoebus Catastrophe along with Apollo. She taught the skill of hunting to Chiron as one of his many lessons from the gods.

__In Fate/Grand Order:__ 
~!Artemis was summoned while having Orion as an accessory. To make a correction however, that is the opposite. Upon summoning Orion, a hero of Greek Mythology, for some reason, the goddess Artemis also came along. Harboring uneasiness towards the abnormality of the present situation, Artemis trespassed by wedging herself into Orion's summoning. She is fulfilling the role of an Archer-class Servant.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order Okeanos:__  
~!Sensing Orion would be summoned, Artemis lowered her divinity to make herself his substitute out of concern. This however resulted in Orion becoming a little bear creature. Not knowing why they summoned, the couple traveled from island to island in search of information. Before Chaldea’s arrival, they’ve searched two islands to no avail.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order Solomon:__  
~!Artemis and Orion are amongst the "Okeanos" Singularity Servants to aid Chaldea against the Demon Gods Pillar. Orion complains to Artemis that his appearance doesn't look impressive and hopes to have his original form back.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order Cosmos in the Lostbelt:__ 
~!Within the world of the Lostbelt, there was a shift from the Greater History of Man in 12,000 BC that ultimately led to the Age of Gods continuing into the modern day. After surviving the Olympiamachia, Zeus reprogrammed her to serve as one of the Atlantis' three defense layers, placed in the low orbit as a kinetic bombardment weapon, mercilessly judging and striking down any external threat to Olympus.!~

name.native: セレニケ・アイスコル・ユグドミレニア

node.description: Astolfo's first master during Fate/Apocrypha.

Laeticia is a French girl who is chosen by the Holy Grail as a match for the materialization of Ruler Jeanne d'Arc in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. After accepting the role, her personality is temporarily suppressed for most of the war.

Caster of Black is the Caster-class Servant of Roche Frain Yggdmillennia of the Black Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha.

~!He also becomes the proxy Master of Berserker of Red after capturing him.!~

~!Caster's True Name is Avicebron (アヴィケブロン, Avikeburon), also known as Solomon ibn Gabirol (ソロモン・イブン・ガビーロール, Soromon ibun Gabīrōru), a twelfth-century poet and philosopher. He was born in Malaga, Spain, and although he did not have the glory of a knight or king or the recognition of having produced works of art that would prosper for thousands of years, he was the father of an entire thaumaturgical system, Kabbalah, and one of the starting points of the process leading up to the European Renaissance through bringing Greco-Arabic and Jewish lore and enlightenment to the cultural circles of Europe. He is recognized as a "hero" who heavily influenced both the history of the world and thaumaturgy.!~

name.native: ユスティーツァ・リズライヒ・フォン・アインツベルン

node.description:
Justeaze was the head of the Einzbern family two hundred years ago. Well acquainted with Zouken Matou, they had a dream of reaching a utopia that could eliminate and cure all hatred and suffering. Though they wished to exceed the limits of humanity by surpassing the body and reaching the soul, they were particular about reaching that state while still having human form. They were also acquainted with Nagato Tohsaka and Kischur Zelretch Schweinorg, considered a potential inheritor of the Jeweled Sword of Zelretch if not for Zelretch appraising the family as fundamentally evil. Along with the family's then eight hundred year wish of retrieving their lost Third Magic, they sought to use the Holy Grail to reach that miracle. She was born to become the core of the Greater Grail, and she was the one to devise the ritual. Accompanied by Nagato and Zouken, who provided necessary land and starting materials for the ritual, and being watched over by Kischur Zelretch Schweinorg, she was sacrificed as the key to reenacting the ancient sorcery.

(Source: Type-moon Wiki)

name.native: ゴルドルフ・ムジーク

node.description: Goredolf Musik is the new owner and director of Chaldea Security Organization. After the events of Epic of Remnant, he purchased the organization before it could be divided up by the Mage's Association.

A shrewd, powerful, but ancient sorcerer, Zoken is the patriarch of the Matou family and is known to be the grandfather of Shinji and Sakura. He has amassed a large and extensive library of sorcerous knowledge, yet his lessons are strict and harsh. Zoken considers Shinji to be a disgrace of a sorcerer and believes Sakura may have more potential than her brother.

name.native: カウレス・フォルヴェッジ・ユグドミレニア

node.description:
Berserker of "Red" (“赤”のバーサーカー, "Aka" no Bāsākā) is the Berserker-class Servant of Deimlet Pentel of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. Shirou Kotomine assumes command over him before he even meets his Master, but Berserker goes rogue before Shirou enacts his plan to officially become his Master.

~!He is instead forced to contract with Caster of Black when captured by the Black Faction.!~
~!Berserker's True Name is Spartacus (スパルタクス, Suparutakusu), the strongest Gladiator and the ringleader who raised a large-scale rebellion of slaves in Ancient Rome known as the War of Spartacus.!~
Is a female homunculus of Yggdmillennia.

Fionn was the unparalleled leader of the Knights of Fianna of Erin, an "almighty group of knights", and friend of Diarmuid Ua Duibhne. 
When Fionn was to be betrothed to his third wife and daughter of the High King, Gráinne, they put on a large banquet to celebrate the occasion, feeling as if the engagement was more joyous than any other. Due to Gráinne begging Diarmuid to take her away from there, the two ran away together, and Fionn, filled with jealousy and resentment, mobilized all of his resources to hunt them down. 

__In Fate/Grand Order:__ 
~!Fionn serves as a part of the Celtic army under Medb. He is partnered with Diarmuid Ua Duibhne, whom he constantly reminds of his affair. 
Fionn's appearance is of when he was at the prime of his life as a knight, brimming with elegance and charm as if he was shining. It reflects the time of his more youthful years before he had lost seven years of his youth from a conflict with a fairy over his first wife.!~

__In Fate/Zero:__ 
~!Fionn's appearance in the Fate/Zero anime is much more regal with him as a king, presumably after his youth was stolen by the fairy.!~

__In Fate/Apocrypha:__ 
~!Fionn is briefly shown during a flashback to the Third Holy Grail War, summoned by Darnic Prestone Yggdmillennia.!~

node.description: Trimmau is a maid golem currently serving Reines El-Melloi Archisorte. She was formerly the Mystic Code of Kayneth El-Melloi Archibald, Volumen Hydrargyrum, before being inherited and reworked by Lord El-Melloi II.

node.description: Gunther is the King of Burgundy during the time of the legend of Siegfried in the Nibelungenlied.
She is the mother of Jeanne d'Arc.

Hagen is known as the killer of Siegfried in the Nibelungenlied. Due to Siegfried's nature as someone who did as he asked without question, he was involved in the dilemma between his brother-in-law, Gunther, and the woman Gunther desired, Brünnhilde. As the various circumstances came to a head, Siegfried was left with no choice but to die to stop conflict between Brünnhilde and his own wife, Kriemhild. He exclaimed to his friend Hagen, “Ah, the situation is beyond my control. Hagen, I am invincible and so have never once been wounded by you. But even so, if I don’t have you kill me…”

Mehmed II was an Ottoman sultan who was considered to be a military genius after conquering Constantinople. He led a force of one hundred fifty thousand soldiers to invade Romania in 1462. Vlad III and his force of only ten thousand soldiers managed to repel the invasion. Due to Vlad's tactics of impaling invaders on stakes for prominent display to his enemies, his soldiers' morale sank and he was forced to withdraw. According to Mehmed II's records, he muttered at that moment, "I fear no human. But, Dracula (the devil) is different."

node.description: Head of the Department of Summoning in the Clock Tower.

node.description:
Rottweil Berzinsky, also known Silver Lizard, is the Master of Archer of Red of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha.

Rottweil is a freelance magus. Just like the other Red Masters such as Jean Rum and the Pentel brothers, he has fought both together and against Kairi Sisigou at various times in the past.

He once participated in a subspecies Holy Grail War that has a maximum of five servants. The organizer declared that this subspecies Holy Grail War objective was to gather Magical Energy. His client hired him to take part in the summoning ritual and killing their respective servant. Rottweil was irritated by this task, to which he reacts by killing his client and the other participants. However the gathered Magical Energy ran wild and caused a large explosion which he barely survived. He had to shed his skin twice to recover.

Apart from his face, most of his body is covered in silver scales. It seems that he also has the organs of a lizard as well.

キャビィク・ペンテル

node.description:
Hyouma Sagara is a magus and original Master of Assassin in the prototype short story version of Fate/Apocrypha Act1: Unbirth. He is mentioned to have been the one to summon Assassin in a similar manner in the novel version of Fate/Apocrypha.

Little is known about Sagara's background, but it is known that before becoming a master he was born from a lineage of magi that was commonly looked down upon as "rats". Before the Great Holy Grail War, he was living with a prostitute by the name of Reika Rikudou, who was unaware of the existence of Magecraft, and at some point in time he managed to gain possession of Jack the Ripper's knives.

__In Fate/Strange Fake:__ 

During the True and False Holy Grail Wars, he and many other magi attempt to attack Flat Escardos to get his Command Seals, only to be easily defeated by him and False Berserker. Flat temporarily paralyzes and seals the Magic Circuits of himself, Carl Lexarm, Silvelt Kotcheff, Avi Dikhail, and members of Zugzwang before locking them in his room. When False Berserker unwittingly takes the form of Assassin of Black, he and the other prisoners instinctively shudder in fear much to their own surprise. When Flat refuses to kill them, he and the other prisoners are confused. Flat and False Berserker leave them in the room.

name.native: デムライト・ペンテル

node.description: After the disappearance of ten Yggdmillennia operatives at the hands of Assassin of Black and Reika Rikudou, the Black Faction decides to look into the matter. Caules Forvedge Yggdmillennia and Archer of Black find that Avi was burned to death after having been doused in gasoline and had his heart gouged out. At the suggestion of Althea, Caules uses psychoscopy magecraft to experience Avi's memories. They learn he was slowly tortured for the purpose of gathering information on Yggdmillennia, Avi granting them the knowledge necessary to invade the castle by disabling the security.
